items.title: City of Surrey and Prologis advance proposed lease for major Campbell Heights development

sources.snippet: The City of Surrey and Prologis, a global leader in logistics real estate, are in advanced discussions on a proposed long-term lease that will support significant investment, create hundreds of local jobs and strengthen Surrey’s position as a key economic hub in British Columbia.
